name: shared-service-ownership
goal: Only services with two distinct runtime consumers appear in Services; single-consumer implementations live beside their owner while public contracts and registered identities remain stable

evidence: Require two distinct actual runtime owner units for Services inclusion and Used In links. Colocate all 195 initially confirmed private service capabilities with their owners, preserving identities, implementations and public entries.

The standardized catalog and card-grid suites accepted a single-consumer service and indirect page fallback. Extend their shared fixtures with zero, one, duplicate, missing and shared owners; extend metadata and source-move coverage with service cases and a frozen relocation ledger.

Test commit 13db0192 fails owner-local placement (317 missing moved sources). Immutable red 272452fb7114118e8219f9ec942e9f42c0ae8616866917d3b733713ecedffa73. The same metadata suite fails all eight service-owner cases; browser desktop captures six cards where only the shared service should appear.

Resolved source runtime owners control service inclusion and Used In links. All 195 private implementations live in supported owner areas, with 318 AST comparisons and stable registered identities. Public source imports, framework hooks, store entries and their module contracts are preserved.
